Dr. Sudarshan Singh is a leading Physiotherapist & Chiropractor with 22+ years of experience, internationally certified in Spinal Manipulation and holding a Diploma in Master of Chiropractic Technique. He has successfully treated 25,000+ patients with conditions like back & neck pain, sciatica, frozen shoulder, joint pain, and sports injuries and is rated highest on google reviews in Mumbai.

Based in Thane, he also consults across Mumbai, Pune, Goa & Ahmedabad, delivering results-focused, root-cause treatment.

About JointsnMotion

Founded in 2007 by Dr. Sudarshan Singh & Dr. Karuna Nikam Singh, JointsnMotion is a Physiotherapy & Wellness Center built on:

👉 From Injury to Holistic Health

We combine physiotherapy, chiropractic care, and natural healing to help your body recover, move better, and stay pain-free. Thousands trust us for musculoskeletal & neurodevelopmental care.
